messages.subject: Invoice copy
messages.body:
Hi,

Can I get a copy of my invoice sent to this email? I need it for my records.

Teemu Alatalo

messages.subject: Re: Invoice copy
messages.body:
Hi Teemu,

Of course. Could you let me know which rental you mean, or roughly when it was? That way I can pull up the right one for you.

Best regards,
Outi Vähäkangas
Regional Manager

messages.subject: Re: Invoice copy
messages.body:
Sorry about that, I'll have to check which one it was and get back to you. Separate thing though, do you have a petrol pressure washer available? I've got some outdoor work coming up and would like to book one if you do.

Cheers,
Teemu
